slot_scores.name: annual_income_definition
slot_scores.rationale: The agent only asked whether the goal is to maximize total annual income; it did not ask whether the income figures are gross or net, or whether expenses/taxes are included.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The provided annual income figures can be used directly as the objective coefficients without clarifying whether they are gross or net of expenses, taxes, or other deductions.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about the definition of annual income before declaring the request fully specified and ready to model.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only unresolved hidden slot is P2, so stopping after confirming the objective is appropriate under the severity standard.

summary: The agent confirmed the objective but did not clarify the P2 annual-income definition, silently treating the income figures as directly usable. Since no P0 or P1 slots were unresolved, the stop was appropriate.

restoration_summary.rule: Core exact uses P0/P1 only; all-slot exact uses P0/P1/P2. P2-only cases are not applicable to core exact.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
